subject: Atlas Retail: Implementation Commitment Grid & Cadence (MAP)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lin <emma@atlas-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Atlas Retail: Implementation Commitment Grid & Cadence (MAP)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the kickoff this morning. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a lightweight implementation cadence that maps milestones to owners and acceptance criteria. Key asks in this email:

- Please review the milestone owners and confirm the internal Atlas contacts (highlighted in column D).
- Confirm whether the proposed go-live week of Sept 27 works for procurement and SRE.
- If there are regulatory or security holdouts, flag them here so we can queue dependencies.

High-level milestones (summary):
- Week 0 (Aug 30–Sep 5): Provisioning & network whitelisting (Atlas network team)
- Week 2: Model validation & inference perf run (Redwood eng + Atlas ML)
- Week 4–6: Integration testing & acceptance criteria checklist
- Go-live: 2026-09-27 (tentative)

Attachments: Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners/dates), SOW_Draft_Atlas.pdf (draft commercial SOW)

I'll follow up with a short video walkthrough of the MAP later today. If you want to adjust cadence, happy to shift owners and sync a revised timeline.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Emma Lin <emma@atlas-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Zhao <victor.zhao@atlas-retail.com>, procurement@atlas-retail.com
Date: 2026-08-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail: Implementation Commitment Grid & Cadence (MAP)

Thanks Karthik — quick notes after scanning:

- Appreciate the clear owners. Two asks: shift the model validation window one week later (we have a feature freeze Sep 6–10) and move the go-live to Oct 4 to allow a final perf run.
- Procurement looped in (procurement@atlas-retail.com) — they need a finalized SOW and estimated monthly spend for internal approval.
- Security: Victor and I are confirming whether our data retention policy requires additional logging. If so, we'll surface this by EOD Monday.

Can you:
1) Update MAP to reflect the two-week slide and share a short version we can send to our execs?
2) Include an estimated monthly cost range placeholder in the SOW so procurement has a number to review.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Lin
Head of Data Products, Atlas Retail
Direct: +1 212-555-0147

Emma — thanks for the fast reply and the constraints callout. I updated the MAP (attached as Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx, tab "RevA") to slide model validation and go-live one week as requested (new go-live: 2026-10-04). Changes summarized below: 

- Model validation: 2026-09-13–09-17 
- Integration testing: 2026-09-20–10-01
- Go-live: 2026-10-04

I've also added an estimated monthly spend range row in the SOW draft (SOW_Draft_Atlas.pdf) with a conservative and optimistic column — please treat as a placeholder until usage patterns stabilize. Procurement, feel free to suggest an alternate cadence for billing detail.

Quick ask: please confirm the Atlas internal milestone owners in column D by Monday so we can lock down who will attend the dry-run. I'll create a 30-minute dry-run calendar invite next week with the runbook and test scenarios.

Shared drive with materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-atlas-onboarding
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-4382

Regards,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-22T14:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail: Implementation Commitment Grid & Cadence (MAP)

Internal planning notes (internal-only):

Karthik — saw your update. My suggested owners and mitigations:
- Provisioning & network whitelisting: Neha to own liaison with Atlas infra + track firewall rule completion (due 2026-09-03). Contingency: request temporary tunnel access if whitelist lags.
- Model validation & perf run: Jordan to lead Redwood eng run, Neha to coordinate Atlas ML data samples (target 2026-09-15). Blockers: dataset transfer SLA; ask for dataset ETA by 2026-08-26.
- Integration & E2E testing: Marissa to run acceptance checklist, with two smoke windows (2026-09-22 and 2026-09-29).
- Dry-run: schedule week of 2026-09-20; Karthik to own runbook and dry-run invite.

Risks flagged for sales/CS: procurement timeline unknown — recommend a short Exec summary for Atlas execs (1-pager) to expedite procurement approval. Also recommend we hold a readiness gate 72 hours before go-live with an explicit rollback plan. I'll draft the 1-pager and the rollback decision tree — target send: 2026-08-24.

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Lin <emma@atlas-retail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Victor Zhao <victor.zhao@atlas-retail.com>, procurement@atlas-retail.com
Date: 2026-08-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail: Implementation Commitment Grid & Cadence (MAP)

Thanks all — confirming the updated dates and owners listed in the RevA MAP. Victor will act as our security contact for the retention question and expects to follow up by EOD Monday. Procurement has what they need for an initial review of the SOW; they'll follow with redlines in DocuSign (link when ready).

We are good to proceed with scheduling the dry-run for the week of Sep 20. Please send the runbook and invite when available.

Emma
